# sha1 dump fixtures

These files represent dumps generated from some selected works found using the random transcription link <https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Special:RandomRootpage/Index> on en.wikisource.org

They are dumped with all templates (and apparently subpages, and referenced proofread-page objects included, plus all revisions.

They are quite chunky, so shouldn't be used in tests unless you want something particularly thorough, or representative of live content on en.wikisource.org
